text:
```yaml
name: Private Proof Benchmark

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs at midnight UTC every day

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: useblacksmith/setup-node@v5
      with:
        node-version: '16'
        always-auth: true
        registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org/'
        token: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci

    - name: Run benchmark
      run: npm run benchmark:private:e2e

    - name: Publish benchmark results
      uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1
      with:
        name: 'Private Proof Benchmark'
        tool: 'typescript'
        output-file-path: 'benchmarks/private-proof-e2e/latest.json'
        gh-pages-branch: 'gh-pages'
        gh-repository: 'tetsuo-ai/AgenC'
        benchmark-data-dir-path: 'benchmarks/private-proof-e2e'
        github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        ref: ${{ github.ref }}
        auto-push: true
        skip-fetch-gh-pages: false
        comment-always: true
        summary-always: true
        save-data-file: true
        comment-on-alert: true
        alert-threshold: '10%'
```
